biggest_catch: This is a narrow window - the friend's account must be opened August 1 through October 31, 2026 - and your $50 isn't deposited until 90 days after their account opening.
catches: $50 to the referring member per qualifying referral; promotional deposit cap of $600 per person (12 referrals).
Friend must open an eligible account (with qualified loan or deposit) and mention the referrer's name and code 'SHARE' during account opening.
Friend's account must be opened before October 31, 2026; the $50 deposit lands in the referrer's base share 90 days after account opening, with the account in good standing.
Membership limited to Prince George's County, MD (plus family pass-along); estate and minor accounts excluded.
Promotion subject to end at any time; certain restrictions apply.
